density.name: Airy
density.hint: Lots of space around everything. Calm and premium; good for landing pages.

density.name: Balanced
density.hint: A comfortable middle ground that works for most pages.

density.name: Compact
density.hint: More information per screen. Good for dashboards and admin tools.

shapes.name: Sharp
shapes.hint: Square corners and crisp lines. Serious and precise.

shapes.name: Soft
shapes.hint: Slightly rounded corners and gentle shadows. Friendly but professional.

shapes.name: Rounded / pill
shapes.hint: Very round corners and pill buttons. Playful and approachable.

motion.name: None
motion.hint: Nothing moves. Fastest feeling and fully calm.

motion.name: Subtle
motion.hint: Small hover effects and gentle fades. Feels polished without being distracting.

motion.name: Expressive
motion.hint: Bouncy hovers and noticeable entrance animations. Fun and lively.

imagery.name: Photo placeholders
imagery.hint: Spaces for real photos you will add later. Feels human and concrete.

imagery.name: Abstract shapes / gradients
imagery.hint: Shapes and color instead of pictures. Modern and needs no assets.

imagery.name: None
imagery.hint: Type and layout only. Clean and fast.
